newRoles.title: Cloud Security Engineering
newRoles.text: Responsible for securing cloud environments -- designing and enforcing identity, network, and configuration controls across cloud platforms, and monitoring for misconfiguration and drift.

newRoles.title: Identity and Access Management
newRoles.text: Responsible for designing and operating the systems that control who can access what -- account lifecycle, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, and privileged access.

newRoles.title: Detection Engineering
newRoles.text: Responsible for building, testing, and tuning the detections that alert on attacker behavior, validating coverage against known techniques and working with red teams to close gaps.

newRoles.title: Threat Hunting
newRoles.text: Responsible for proactively searching systems and networks for attackers who evaded existing defenses, forming hypotheses from threat intelligence and testing them against telemetry.

newRoles.title: Application Security
newRoles.text: Responsible for helping development teams build secure software through threat modeling, code review, security testing, and guidance on fixing vulnerabilities.

newRoles.title: DevSecOps
newRoles.text: Responsible for building security into software delivery pipelines and platforms, automating checks so code and infrastructure ship securely by default.

newRoles.title: GRC Analysis
newRoles.text: Responsible for supporting governance, risk, and compliance programs -- mapping controls to frameworks, collecting audit evidence, assessing risk, and tracking remediation.

newRoles.title: Security Awareness
newRoles.text: Responsible for building the training, phishing simulations, and communication that help employees recognize and report threats and reduce human risk.

newRoles.title: Cyber Range Engineering
newRoles.text: Responsible for designing, building, and operating simulated environments for security training, exercises, and testing, combining infrastructure engineering with attack and defense scenarios.

OG-WRL-010.title: Security Program Manager
OG-WRL-010.text: Responsible for planning, running, and reporting on security programs and projects -- scope, budget, schedule, priorities, vendors, and the people and skills the program needs.

PD-WRL-006.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
PD-WRL-006.text: Responsible for collecting and analyzing information about threat actors, their tools, and their techniques, and turning it into intelligence that helps the organization anticipate, detect, and respond to attacks.

PD-WRL-002.text: Responsible for collecting, preserving, and analyzing digital evidence from computers, networks, and devices to investigate incidents and support internal, legal, or law-enforcement processes.
PD-WRL-002.title: Digital Forensics Analyst

DD-WRL-001.title: Security Architect
DD-WRL-001.text: Responsible for designing the security of an organization's systems and technology architecture -- selecting controls, cryptography, and network and identity designs so security requirements are met by design.

DD-WRL-004.title: Security Engineer
DD-WRL-004.text: Responsible for building and maintaining the security of systems and infrastructure -- implementing and hardening controls, securing platforms and networks, and integrating security into how systems are designed, built, and run.

DD-WRL-012.title: Application Security Engineer
DD-WRL-012.text: Responsible for securing software throughout its lifecycle -- building security into code and design, reviewing code and architecture for weaknesses, testing applications for vulnerabilities, and driving the fixes.

OG-WRL-019.title: GRC Analyst
OG-WRL-019.text: Responsible for governance, risk, and compliance work -- writing and maintaining security policies, assessing risk, mapping controls to frameworks, and monitoring ongoing compliance.

PD-WRL-001.title: SOC Analyst
PD-WRL-001.text: Responsible for monitoring, detecting, and triaging security events and alerts across an organization's systems and networks, and escalating and responding to confirmed threats.

removeRolesNote: Roles removed 2026-10-20 (all with the skills, tasks, and knowledge no remaining role uses, except the skills in `rehome`): DD-WRL-007 Systems Testing and Evaluation (military); IO-WRL-001/002/003/004/005/007 and DD-WRL-006, general IT/data jobs that are not security roles (most already exist as Background options); OG-WRL-013 Systems Authorization, OG-WRL-014 Systems Security Management, and IN-WRL-001 Cybercrime Investigation, too government-specific. OG-WRL-006 Cybersecurity Counsel removed 2026-10-20: not a realistic career path for most people (it requires a law degree); all of its skills are shared with other roles, so none were cut.
